definitions.explanation: A bathroom fixture with a basin for washing the face and hands, often with storage and a mirror.

examples.japanese: {洗面台|せんめんだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
examples.english: Wash your face at the washstand.

notes:
A standard fixture in Japanese homes, installed in the ⟦{脱衣所|だついじょ}→脱衣所：17619_datsuijo⟧ (changing room) or ⟦{洗面所|せんめんじょ}→洗面所：17618_senmenjo⟧, separate from the bathing area itself.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{洗面|せんめん}→洗面：04376_senmen⟧⟦ボウル→ボウル：04483_bouru⟧ (basin/bowl)
- ⟦{蛇口|じゃぐち}→蛇口：04218_jaguchi⟧/⟦{水栓|すいせん}→水栓：22083_suisen⟧ (faucet)
- ⟦{鏡|かがみ}→鏡：02190_kagami⟧ (mirror)
- ⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧⟦{棚|だな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ (storage shelf)
- ⟦{照明|しょうめい}→照明：03243_shoumei⟧ (lighting)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洗面台|せんめんだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧ - to wash one's face at the sink
- {洗面台|せんめんだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ - to brush one's teeth at the sink
- {洗面台|せんめんだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to clean the sink

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{洗面化粧台|せんめんけしょうだい}→洗面化粧台：noentry⟧ (vanity unit, the retailer's term)
- ⟦{洗面器|せんめんき}→洗面器：29668_senmenki⟧ (a portable washbasin, not the fixture)
- ⟦{洗面所|せんめんじょ}→洗面所：17618_senmenjo⟧ (the room the {洗面台|せんめんだい} stands in)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Because the Japanese ⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧ is a separate wet room, the {洗面台|せんめんだい} sits outside it, often beside the washing machine. Items commonly kept there: ⟦{歯|は}ブラシ→歯ブラシ：04509_haburashi⟧, ⟦{歯磨|はみが}き{粉|こ}→歯磨き粉：04983_hamigakiko⟧, ⟦{洗顔料|せんがんりょう}→洗顔料：19050_senganryou⟧, ⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧, and a ⟦ドライヤー→ドライヤー：05076_doraiyaa⟧.
